title: Version executor schema
description: Versions a project from its conventional commits with @hyperfrontend/versioning, taking the published version on the npm registry as the source of truth.

dryRun.description: See what commands would be run, without committing to git or updating files.

releaseAs.description: Manually increment the version by that keyword.

tagPrefix.description: Version tag prefix. Default is '{projectName}@' in independent mode.

skipCommit.description: Allows to skip making a commit when bumping a version.

skipTag.description: Allows to skip tagging the release. Default: true (tags created after publish).

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging. Shows additional details about each step.

maxCommitFallback.description: Upper bound on the commit window the flow analyzes for bumps and changelogs.

scopeFiltering.description: Scope filtering configuration for commit classification and changelog generation.

includeScopes.description: Additional scopes to include as direct commits

excludeScopes.description: Scopes to exclude even if files match

trackDependencyChanges.description: Include commits that touch dependency packages as indirect commits

paths.description: Git paths to track as infrastructure (e.g., 'tools/', '.github/')
